summary.text: Jim Halverson is a Republican state representative from District 21 who took office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Jim Halverson's career experience includes working as an electrician, according to Ballotpedia.
He assumed office in the South Dakota House of Representatives on January 14, 2025, and serves on the House Education Committee and the House Health and Human Services Committee.
